name: 55705 · Aurora, MN
findings: ZIP 55705 (Aurora) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55705 (Aurora) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55705 (Aurora) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
